I had an attempt at projects here -- https://github.com/dxos/dxos/pull/9825/files#diff-2286002fbe2ab6e5b1c991e08d3d4ad24072a29a1ee4dd631a9c5722ebfe36f2

It worked but I didn't wanna merge it since it changed the behaviour of `pnpm vite run` -- it would run all projects.

Perhaps a good iteration would be to use projects, but have the `baseConfig` only provide the right projects (nodejs, browser, storybook) based on options and `VITEST_ENV`. This would match existing behaviour while transitioning us to project-based config.

author: dmaretskyi
body:
When using Effect.fn provide the name `Effect.fn('myFunc')(function* ({}) { ... })`.
But here you are in a test so you don't need Effect.fn -- use `Effect.fnUntraced(function* () { .. })`

NOTE: There's a type-inference issue with functions that ignore their parameters. I found that in tests putting `{}` as the parameter pattern works around the issue:

```ts
Effect.fnUntraced(function* ({}) { // <---- no error

})
```
